listings.thesis: Metal recycling could capture circularity demand as AI hardware, cabling and facility materials scale
listings.valuationNote: Qualitative valuation setup; no reliable non-US quote snapshot returned by finance tool

priorCase.rankRationale: New June 17 FY26 EBIT upgrade (AUD 420-435M vs 350-400M) is a genuine fundamental positive, but driven by ferrous/non-ferrous scrap markets and Lifecycle Services, not AI-hardware circularity. It strengthens the company without strengthening the AI-node alpha thesis; the further run also erodes 'latent' character. Small +1 for the beat; hold rank on a strict screen.
